d: The recent Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) student protest once again showed how youth movements can force those in power to listen. In this episode of Tarikh by The Lallantop, we trace the history of three of the world's most influential student movements- from France's May 1968 uprising (Night of the Barricades) to China's 1989 Tiananmen Square protests and India's JP Movement (Sampoorna Kranti). Discover the story behind the iconic Tank Man, Jayaprakash Narayan's call for Total Revolution, the Emergency of 1975, and how student protests have repeatedly reshaped politics, democracy, civil…
